Risk Description: Employee account compromise could expose customer records
Business Impact: Financial loss and reputational damage and potential regulatory consequences
Recommended Controls: Phishing-resistant MFA and least privilege and access monitoring
Evidence Required: MFA configuration and access review reports

Risk Description: Theft of an employee laptop could expose confidential customer documents
Business Impact: Customer data exposure and financial loss and reputational damage
Recommended Controls: Full-disk encryption and strong device authentication and remote-wipe capability
Evidence Required: Device encryption compliance report and last check-in timestamps

Risk Description: Compromised Microsoft 365 account could expose company emails and documents
Assumed Vulnerability: Weak authentication and inadequate sign-in monitoring
Business Impact: Confidential data exposure and business disruption
Recommended Controls: Phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access and sign-in monitoring
Evidence Required: MFA configuration and sign-in monitoring reports

Risk Description: Ransomware infection could encrypt employee devices and disrupt operations
Assumed Vulnerability: Unpatched devices and inadequate endpoint protection
Recommended Controls: Endpoint protection and patch management and application controls
Evidence Required: Endpoint compliance and patch management reports

Risk Description: Unauthorised access could expose confidential employee records
Business Impact: Employee privacy harm and potential regulatory consequences
Recommended Controls: Role-based access control and periodic access reviews
Evidence Required: HR access permissions and access review records

Risk Description: Employees could disclose confidential information through unapproved generative AI tools
Assumed Vulnerability: No approved AI usage policy or data sharing restrictions
Business Impact: Confidential information exposure and potential contractual consequences
Recommended Controls: AI acceptable use policy and approved tools and employee training
Evidence Required: AI tool inventory and approved use policy and training records

Risk Description: Attackers could compromise the company website through exploitable software weaknesses
Assumed Vulnerability: Outdated website components and inadequate security testing
Recommended Controls: Security patching and vulnerability scanning and secure configuration
Evidence Required: Website vulnerability reports and patch records

Risk Description: Backups could fail during recovery from a cybersecurity incident
Assumed Vulnerability: Inadequate backup monitoring and restore testing
Business Impact: Extended business disruption and potential data loss
Recommended Controls: Protected backups and scheduled restore testing and recovery procedures
Evidence Required: Backup job reports and documented restore test results

Risk Description: Excessive access privileges could enable unauthorised changes or data exposure
Assumed Vulnerability: Weak privilege management and missing access reviews
Business Impact: Unauthorised data access and system compromise
Recommended Controls: Least privilege and privileged access management and access reviews
Evidence Required: Privileged account inventory and access review evidence

Risk Description: Phishing could lead to business email compromise and fraudulent payments
Assumed Vulnerability: Insufficient email protection and phishing awareness
Business Impact: Financial loss and confidential information exposure
Recommended Controls: Email authentication and phishing-resistant MFA and payment verification procedures
Evidence Required: Email security configuration and awareness records and payment control procedures
